reviews.body: Top notch service from Fernán. Wasted no time, he was quick and efficient to giving me a clean cut. Highly recommend the shop and Fernan, good quality stuff

reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.body: Fernan is really good I asked for a low taper and he nailed it perfectly. His attention to detail is good and the lines are incredibly sharp. The shop vibe is fantastic, and the service was amazing . If you want a top-tier haircut, book an appointment with Fernan
